benefits.name: SNAP (Food Assistance)
benefits.description: Provides monthly benefits to help low-income individuals and families purchase food.

benefits.name: Housing Assistance/Section 8
benefits.description: Offers rental assistance to low-income households, helping them afford safe and stable housing.

benefits.name: Medicaid (Healthcare)
benefits.description: Provides low-cost or free health coverage to eligible individuals and families, including doctor visits, hospital care, and prescription drugs.

benefits.name: TANF (Cash Assistance)
benefits.description: Provides temporary cash assistance and work support services to low-income families with children to help them meet basic needs.

benefits.name: SSI (Supplemental Security Income)
benefits.description: Provides monthly payments to individuals who are elderly, blind, or disabled and have limited income and resources.

benefits.name: SSDI (Social Security Disability)
benefits.description: Provides monthly benefits to individuals who are unable to work due to a medical condition expected to last at least 12 months or result in death.

benefits.name: Unemployment Insurance
benefits.description: Provides temporary income support to workers who have lost their job through no fault of their own.

benefits.name: WIC (Women, Infants, Children)
benefits.description: Provides nutritional support to eligible pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, and young children through food benefits and nutrition education.

benefits.name: LIHEAP (Utility Assistance)
benefits.description: Helps low-income households pay heating, cooling, and electricity bills, as well as emergency energy-related repairs.

benefits.name: CHIP (Children's Health Insurance)
benefits.description: Provides low-cost health insurance coverage for uninsured children in families that earn too much for Medicaid.

benefits.name: CCA Child Care Assistance
benefits.description: Helps eligible low-income families pay for child care so they can work, attend school, or participate in job training.

benefits.name: EITC (Earned Income Tax Credit)
benefits.description: A tax credit for low-income workers that reduces taxes owed and may provide a refund, rewarding work and offsetting the cost of living.

benefits.name: Veterans Benefits (VA)
benefits.description: Provides disability compensation, pensions, and other support services to eligible veterans and their families.

benefits.name: General/Emergency Assistance
benefits.description: Provides emergency financial assistance to individuals facing immediate hardship or crisis situations.

benefits.name: Food Pantry Services
benefits.description: Community-based food distribution programs providing free groceries to individuals and families in need.

benefits.name: CADC (Case Management/Support)
benefits.description: Professional support services helping clients navigate benefits, find employment, and access community resources.

benefits.name: Emergency Housing Assistance
benefits.description: Provides emergency financial aid for eviction prevention, rental assistance, and temporary housing placement.

benefits.name: Public Transit Assistance
benefits.description: Subsidized or free public transportation passes helping low-income individuals get to work and access services.

benefits.name: Lifeline Phone Program
benefits.description: Provides discounted or free phone service to eligible low-income households to help them stay connected.

benefits.name: Job Training/WIOA Programs
benefits.description: Provides free job training, career counseling, and employment services to help individuals enter or advance in the workforce.
